# Browser document libraries

pdfjs-dist 6.4.299 (Apache-2.0), installed from npm, upstream https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js . Bundled build and worker are unmodified.

mammoth 1.13.0 (BSD-2-Clause), installed from npm, upstream https://github.com/mwilliamson/mammoth.js . Browser build unmodified.

See PDFJS-LICENSE and MAMMOTH-LICENSE.
